summary: Worker J. Smith experienced a near-miss incident when a falling object approached the hard hat at a closing rate of 4.2 m/s, with an estimated time to contact of 0.8 seconds. The object was detected by rear sensor R2 at a range of 3.40 meters before passing by without impact. The worker was wearing the hard hat at the time of the event, and no physical contact with the hat was observed.

sequence_of_events.description: Rear sensor R2 warned of an approaching object closing at 4.2 m/s, with approximately 0.9 s to contact and 3.40 m away, with readings ranging from 2.65 m away.
A warning pulse was emitted on the back motor.
Near miss confirmed on rear sensor R2: an object was closing at 4.2 m/s, with approximately 0.8 s to contact and 3.40 m away, with no impact detected.
Range sensor R2 detected 51 valid echoes, with the closest echo at 0.10 m.

evidence.environment: Near-wearer conditions (indicative; the sensor is biased by the wearer's breath and head heat): CO2 612 ppm, temperature 21.4 C, relative humidity 38%.

risk.severity_justification: A direct impact could have resulted in serious head injury.
risk.likelihood_justification: The closing rate and short time to contact indicate a high probability of impact if no corrective action was taken.

immediate.description: Lack of overhead protection in the work area.

root_five_whys: Material was not properly stored or secured after use.
Why was it not properly stored?
Lack of clear procedures for material storage and handling.
Insufficient training and supervision on site material management.

corrective_actions.description: Develop and implement a comprehensive site material management plan, including secure storage and handling procedures.
Provide additional training to all workers on safe material handling and storage practices.
Assess the need for overhead protection in areas where falling objects pose a risk.

regulatory_note: This event may meet the criteria for a provincial serious-incident or dangerous-occurrence notification. Verify with your provincial OHS regulator.
confidence_and_gaps: The view was consistently obstructed by a grey object throughout the clip, limiting the ability to fully assess the event. The exact nature of the falling object is unknown. No video was available for review. The location of the incident on the site is unknown.
